articles.title: Real Madrid vs Málaga en Fútbol Libre o Roja Directa: una búsqueda peligrosa para las contraseñas
articles.text:
Buscar el partido entre Real Madrid y Málaga por La Liga española en aplicaciones como Fútbol Libre o Roja Directa, conocidas por ofrecer eventos deportivos gratuitos de manera ilegal, puede ser la puerta de entrada a amenazas digitales, como el malware o el robo de contraseñas.
El Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad de España (INCIBE) alerta que los servicios piratas, lejos de ser solo una alternativa gratuita, pueden comprometer la seguridad personal de quienes los utilizan. El atractivo de ver gratis un encuentro deportivo puede terminar costando mucho más que una suscripción legal.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué amenazas enfrenta un dispositivo al instalar una app ilegal
El INCIBE advierte que la instalación de aplicaciones de origen dudoso puede derivar en la exposición a malware y otros programas maliciosos. Entre las amenazas más comunes se encuentra el robo de datos personales y el uso fraudulento del propio dispositivo para perpetrar delitos informáticos.
En ocasiones, los usuarios sufren la pérdida de acceso a sus archivos más valiosos, como fotos o documentos personales, por un ataque de ransomware. En estos casos, aparece un mensaje que exige un pago a cambio de recuperar la información, lo que suele derivar en la pérdida definitiva de los datos si no se gestiona correctamente.
PUBLICIDAD
Además, muchas de estas aplicaciones generan una ralentización notable del celular o muestran anuncios invasivos sin previo aviso. Según la autoridad, estas aplicaciones pueden redirigir a sitios web fraudulentos o recopilar datos personales, todo sin el conocimiento del usuario.
Cómo pueden robar las contraseñas sin que el usuario lo sepa
El riesgo de perder el control de las contraseñas va más allá del conocido phishing. El INCIBE informa que algunas aplicaciones piratas instalan keyloggers, programas que registran cada pulsación realizada en la pantalla del celular. Así, los ciberdelincuentes obtienen acceso directo a credenciales bancarias, cuentas de correo o redes sociales.
PUBLICIDAD
Otra técnica utilizada consiste en aprovechar los permisos excesivos que solicita la app durante su instalación. Según el INCIBE, hay aplicaciones capaces de leer los mensajes SMS recibidos en el dispositivo.
En consecuencia, pueden interceptar códigos de verificación o autenticación necesarios para completar transacciones financieras, vulnerando la seguridad personal y facilitando fraudes bancarios.
Qué señales indican que una aplicación puede ser fraudulenta
La prevención comienza antes de instalar cualquier aplicación en el dispositivo. Se debe verificar siempre la procedencia de la app, priorizando las tiendas oficiales como Google Play o App Store.
PUBLICIDAD
Estas plataformas cuentan con filtros de seguridad y revisiones periódicas para detectar apps maliciosas. Descargar aplicaciones desde enlaces sospechosos o tiendas no oficiales incrementa el riesgo de infección.
Asimismo, es fundamental revisar los permisos solicitados durante la instalación. Si una aplicación pide acceso a la cámara, contactos o ubicación sin justificación, conviene denegar dichos permisos o eliminar la app para evitar posibles amenazas.
PUBLICIDAD
Revisar opiniones y valoraciones de otros usuarios ayuda a identificar problemas recurrentes o posibles fraudes, como señala el INCIBE.
Cómo proteger la información guardada en el dispositivo
El INCIBE insiste en que la seguridad digital parte de la disciplina en la descarga de apps. Optar siempre por tiendas oficiales como Play Store o App Store reduce la exposición al software malicioso. Estas plataformas eliminan rápidamente las apps identificadas como peligrosas, protegiendo así a la comunidad de usuarios.
PUBLICIDAD
Mantener actualizado el sistema operativo y las aplicaciones instaladas es otra medida sugerida. Las actualizaciones corrigen vulnerabilidades y refuerzan la seguridad general del dispositivo.
Para una protección adicional, la autoridad experta española sugiere instalar un antivirus de confianza, que permita detectar y eliminar amenazas antes de que comprometan la información personal. Se sugiere realizar copias de seguridad periódicas para recuperar datos en caso de robo, pérdida o infección por malware.

articles.title: Jagdish Farshan raises Rs 43.5 cr led by Sharrp Ventures
articles.text:
Jagdish Farshan raises Rs 43.5 Cr led by Sharrp Ventures
This Gujarat based regional snack brand will use this capital for expansion related activities
Jagdish Farshan, the Gujarat based snack brand has raised Rs 43.5 crore in a Series A round of funding led by Sharrp Ventures, the investment office of Harsh Mariwala, Founder and Chairman of Marico Limited, alongside a group of angel investors.
Jagdish Farshan will deploy this capital towards geographic expansion, manufacturing and supply-chain capacity, retail and institutional distribution, technology and digital commerce.
This is the first institutional capital raised by Jagdish Farshan as the company looks to expand beyond the state of Gujarat. It currently operates 27 retail outlets across central Gujarat, alongside two outlets in North America.
On the funding raised, Jagdish Farshan CEO Aakash Kandoi said, “This fundraise is about building Jagdish Farshan for the next 100 years. We have a strong foundation of consumer trust, product quality and a deep understanding of the Indian snacks and sweets category. We are now at a point where we can take what we have built in Gujarat and scale it across the country, without compromising on the qualities that have made the brand relevant for generations.”
Established in 1938, the range of products by Jagdish Farshan include snacks, namkeen and sweets. It has a portfolio of 500+ products/SKUs and a presence across multiple markets, supported by manufacturing capabilities and an expanding distribution network across retail and institutional channels.
The statement said the investment has come at a time when established regional food brands are seeking to move beyond regional markets by investing in organised manufacturing, wider distribution and digital-first channels. In this market, Jagdish Farshan aims to combine its product heritage and regional strength with a modern operating platform to deepen existing markets and expand into new geographies.
Divya Gupta, Principal, Sharrp Ventures, said: “Jagdish Farshan combines decades of consumer trust and product heritage with the opportunity to build a much larger organised food business.”

articles.title: 12 TB Valve Archive Leaks Online, Fans Dig Through Early Portal 2 and Half-Life Clues
articles.text:
Sunday, August 30th 2026
	
		
	
	
	
12 TB Valve Archive Leaks Online, Fans Dig Through Early Portal 2 and Half-Life Clues
A gigantic 12-terabyte archive from Valve's old Steam2 content servers has leaked online, containing internal development builds spanning from 2003 to 2013. The trove includes a July 2009 build of Portal 2 with unused sequences and beta menus, along with assets from F-Stop, the canceled Portal prequel. There's also a playable 2008 build of Left 4 Dead and early Counter-Strike: Global Offensive content. 
The most talked-about find is a "Weaponizer" model appearing in the Portal 2 files, long rumored to be a concept weapon from the canceled Half-Life 2: Episode Three. The model has surfaced before, but never inside an actual game build, so its presence here is of some significance. However, it may simply have been repurposed as an unrelated placeholder asset.Contrary to how it may appear at first, the leak wasn't the result of a hack. It comes from an old, publicly accessible Steam2 endpoint that Valve apparently never took offline after migrating to SteamPipe in 2013. Valve hasn't commented on this leak, and given the size of the archive, it will likely take the community days or weeks to fully sort through everything inside it.
		
		Source:
				Gabe Follower on X

articles.title: Tesla Model 3 : l’autonomie augmente sans nouvelle batterie, voici le petit secret d’Elon Musk
articles.text:
Tesla Model 3 : l’autonomie augmente sans nouvelle batterie, voici le petit secret d’Elon Musk
Pour rehausser l’autonomie de la Model 3, Tesla n’est pas allé chercher bien loin, en s’attaquant à un élément clé de nos voitures électriques et thermiques : les pneumatiques.
Après la Renault 5 E-Tech, qui améliorait récemment son aérodynamisme pour gagner en autonomie, Tesla est de retour pour jouer sur un tableau similaire. Sans toucher à la batterie, mais uniquement aux pneus, le constructeur automobile d’Elon Musk a en effet donné un boost de presque 40 km d’autonomie à la Model 3. Un simple changement qui a permis de faire tomber la consommation électrique de la berline d’un peu moins de 1 kWh aux 100 km. Le Model Y a de son côté droit à un nouvel intérieur.
De nouveaux pneus sur la Model 3 pour 38 km d’autonomie en plus
La voiture électrique d’entrée de gamme de Tesla, la Model 3 Propulsion, sort maintenant d’usine avec de nouveaux pneumatiques, conçus par le manufacturier singapourien Giti. D’après l’entreprise, ils ont l’avantage d’offrir “une excellente tenue de route et une faible résistance au roulement”, ce qui permet d’améliorer l’autonomie.
La consommation mixte WLTP chute effectivement de 13 kWh/100 km à 12,2 kWh/100 km, soit une baisse de 0,8 kWh/100 km, permettant ainsi de gagner 38 km d’autonomie sur une charge. Une hausse notable qui rapproche le rayon d’action global du véhicule des 600 km, en grimpant de 534 km à 572 km. Côté performances, rien ne change, avec un 0 à 100 km/h abattu en 6,2 secondes et une vitesse maximale de 201 km/h.
En plus d’avantager les nouveaux acheteurs, ce changement présente aussi un intérêt direct pour les propriétaires actuels. Étant donné que l’amélioration repose uniquement sur la monte de nouveaux pneumatiques et n’implique aucun bridage logiciel, il suffira de choisir les mêmes références lors du prochain remplacement de train de pneus pour profiter de ce gain de kilomètres.
Pour rappel, la Tesla Model 3 est toujours affichée à un prix de départ de 36 990 € hors aides. Si on ajoute le bonus de reprise de 3 000 € et la prime CEE de 400 €, il est possible de l’acheter à partir de 33 590 €.
Un nouvel intérieur “Gris Zen” pour le Model Y
En parallèle, Tesla apporte une mise à jour esthétique à l’habitacle de son SUV électrique, le Model Y. Réservée à la version Premium, une finition intérieure baptisée “Gris Zen” fait son entrée au catalogue pour remplacer le blanc traditionnel.
Facturée 1 200 €, cette option très claire habille la sellerie, la console centrale, les contre-portes et le bandeau décoratif de la planche de bord. Le prix à payer pour ne pas se retrouver avec la sellerie noire de série.

articles.title: MapQuest's app surges to No. 1 in Navigation after refusing to rename Lake Ontario | TechCrunch
articles.text:
MapQuest stood up to President Donald Trump, and now its app is reaping the rewards.
The “OG of online mapping,” as the company calls itself, announced on Thursday that it would not change the name of Lake Ontario on its maps to Lake America, despite Trump’s executive order directing the U.S. Department of the Interior to update the lake’s name in the U.S. geographic naming service. As a result, MapQuest’s mobile app downloads soared, sending the iOS app to the No. 4 position on the U.S. App Store’s Top Charts for apps (not including games) as of Monday morning on the U.S. east coast.
MapQuest also reached the No. 8 position overall in the U.S. App Store across both apps and games, and it became the No. 1 Navigation app in the United States.
In Canada’s App Store, the app reached No. 2 overall as of Sunday evening.
The 30-year-old company remarked that it received “hundreds of thousands” of new downloads since its decision to keep the name Lake Ontario in place, and saw its app’s usage climb to 50 times above its normal levels.
Third-party data from market intelligence provider Sensor Tower confirms the surge, noting that MapQuest saw 184,000 and 162,000 total global and U.S. app downloads respectively during the week beginning August 24, each representing an increase of more than 10x week-over-week. In the U.S., daily downloads were up 128% day-over-day from August 26 to August 30.
“We took the same approach we did with the Gulf of Mexico: be part of the conversation, and give people an app that keeps the names they’re familiar with,” said Doug Berger, General Manager of MapQuest, in a statement. “Hundreds of thousands of people signaled to us this weekend that we got it right by downloading our app.”
MapQuest also released an online tool that lets you jokingly rename Lake Ontario to whatever you want it to be, then share the results on social media. The company had offered a similar tool last year, after Trump renamed the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America.
Trump’s decision to rename the body of water bordering the U.S and Canada comes as trade talks broke down, leading the U.S. to impose new 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, with Canada poised to retaliate.
On Saturday, Google Maps announced it was complying with Trump’s decision, explaining that it updates Google Maps to reflect the name changes in official government sources. In the U.S., that’s the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS). The updated map will only be shown to users in the U.S., while those in Canada will see Lake Ontario, and those outside of the two countries will see both names.
Both Apple Maps and Google Maps previously changed the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America last year, after Trump issued a similar name-changing executive order.
As of Monday morning, Apple Maps has yet to rename the Great Lake to Lake America and has not issued a statement about its plans.
MapQuest has changed hands several times over the years, having been acquired by AOL shortly after going public. It then ended up with Verizon for a time, as a result of Verizon’s acquisition of AOL. In 2019, Verizon sold MapQuest to internet advertising company System1.
MapQuest’s app has been downloaded 687,000 times worldwide this year so far, up 29% year-over-year, SensorTower estimated. Since 2012, MapQuest has been downloaded 24.4 million times, with 97% of those installs coming from the United States.

articles.title: Lake Ontario now 'Lake America' on Google Maps in the U.S.
articles.text:
U.S. President Donald Trump signed an order to rename Lake Ontario to “Lake America,” on August 27.
Since then, Google Maps has changed the name of the lake depending on which side of the border you’re on.
The Lake Ontario label changes depending on where you’re based.
- Canadian users will see Lake Ontario
- US users will see Lake America
- Everyone else will see Lake Ontario (Lake America)
This is a similar approach to what Google did when Trump renamed the Gulf of Mexico, the Gulf of America. Google says that its policy is to use the name assigned by the U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS).
How the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) Lake Ontario/Lake America name change in the US will appear on Google Maps pic.twitter.com/nFw80TwaqH
— News from Google (@NewsFromGoogle) August 30, 2026
Apple Maps, on the other hand, hasn’t yet made any changes. Apple Maps did change Gulf of America, though, so I wouldn’t be surprised if we see a similar update with Lake America, but I’m hoping that Apple stands up against the man.
Le nom du lac Ontario tire son origine du mot wendat « Ontari’io », qui signifie « le lac est beau, le lac est grand ».
Ce nom remonte à plus de 400 ans, bien avant la Confédération canadienne et la Déclaration d’indépendance des États-Unis d’Amérique.

articles.title: DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible — most games tank to single digits, high-end GPUs can hit up to 40 FPS in some cases
articles.text:
DLSS 5 mod brings next-gen tech to old Ampere GPUs, but frame rates are horrible — most games tank to single digits, high-end GPUs can hit up to 40 FPS in some cases
The leaked DLL that keeps on giving.
Nvidia's upcoming DLSS 5 neural rendering tech leaked earlier this week through a pre-release version of the DLL inside NBA 2K27 (which is in early access). The community quickly got it working on RTX 50-series GPUs, some of the best graphics cards, but modders later patched the DLL to work on RTX 40-series GPUs, too. Now, thanks to rapid development in the RenoDX Discord server, the DLL has once again been patched to work on RTX 30-series GPUs.
Scouring through the server, the general sentiment is mixed. DLSS 5 works on Ampere cards, but performance tanks in almost every case. Any time a user shows decent framerates, it comes at the cost of base visual fidelity. To use DLSS 5 to make the game look more realistic, you need to turn the in-game settings all the way down. It's a balancing act to avoid the point of diminishing returns.
The net result is a more photorealistic image that looks noticeably different (better?) than native rendering. However, it introduces an insane latency penalty where most of the frame pacing is now formed exclusively by neural rendering. In worst-case scenarios, your frametimes can multiply by ten compared to before. If all of this still sounds enticing, then let's talk about the results.
View Original
View Original
View Original
View Original
One user got Grand Theft Auto V running at around 20-30 FPS on an RTX 3080 Ti at 1440p. Another user played Dying Light 2 at roughly 40 FPS on an RTX 3080 but noted that the image was very noisy. Hogwarts Legacy was running at 30 FPS on an RTX 3090; Mortal Shell 2 at 34 FPS on RTX 3080 Ti, but with shimmering; Ready or Not at 30 FPS on RTX 3080; Neverness to Everness at 29-30 FPS on RTX 3080; and even NBA 2K27 on a mobile RTX 3070 at 25 FPS with DLAA at 1080.
On the other hand, many users reported being stuck in single-digit FPS territory across a variety of games. You'd expect bad performance from RTX 3050 and RTX 3060 users, but the worst we saw was 2 FPS for Hogwarts Legacy on RTX 3070. One person on X enjoyed Deep Rock Galactic with DLSS 5 at 4 FPS on their RTX 3080, down from 130+ FPS without it. Back on Discord, one user ran Cyberpunk 2077 at 7 FPS on an RTX 3080 Ti.
The most interesting result we saw was beautifully emblematic of this entire predicament. A user reached up to 41 FPS in Cyberpunk 2077 with DLSS 5. But to get there, they had to drop the resolution to 720p and use the ultra performance preset for upscaling. As mentioned earlier, you sacrifice base fidelity in order to gain the neural fidelity, if that's your cup of tea.
People seemed so impressed by DLSS 5 that several were ready to sell their Ampere cards for Blackwell GPUs for their servers. The jump from RTX 30-series to RTX 50-series is substantial, but the biggest improvements were made in the AI department. It's a fascinating case study to see people vehemently reject AI at first, then pivot to make purchasing decisions explicitly based on the most AI features possible afterward.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Nvidia still hasn't officially announced when DLSS 5 is dropping or what GPUs it will support. DLSS 4.5, the latest iteration of the tech, supports RTX GPUs all the way back to the RTX 20-series. However, it's not rocket science to deduce that the RTX 50-series will be the first to receive DLSS 5, because it's the only family that can natively read certain FP8 libraries that DLSS 5 depends on.

articles.title: Elster-Phishing: So schützt du dich vor den gefälschten Steuerbescheiden
articles.text:
Gefälschte Elster-Steuerbescheide 2025: So erkennt ihr den Phishing-Betrug
Cyberkriminelle versuchen aktuell, über vermeintliche Steuererstattungen an sensible Daten zu gelangen. Die Masche hinter dem Phishingversuch: eine angebliche Identitätsprüfung des Steuerportals Elster.
Betreff der Phishing-Email: „Ihr Steuerbescheid 2025 – Erstattung bestätigt“
Das offizielle und kostenlose Onlineportal der deutschen Finanzverwaltung wird in Deutschland von mehr als 22 Millionen Bürger:innen und Unternehmen genutzt, um Steuererklärungen, Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und Belege direkt und papierlos an das Finanzamt zu übermitteln.
Der Betrugsversuch läuft laut einer Mitteilung der Verbraucherzentrale, in der auch ein Bild des gefälschten Anschreibens zu sehen ist, so ab: In einer E‑Mail mit dem Betreff „Ihr Steuerbescheid 2025 – Erstattung bestätigt“ wird über eine vermeintlich bestätigte Steuererstattung informiert.
Cyberkriminelle bauen auch Zeitdruck durch Frist auf
Allerdings müsse für die Auszahlung der Erstattung zunächst eine angebliche Freigabe über eine Identitätsprüfung erfolgen, bei der die Kartendaten des hinterlegten Bankkontos bestätigt werden sollen.
Vorgenommen werde die Bestätigung der Kartendaten über das Elster-Portal. Um diese zu starten, gibt es in der E‑Mail einen Link. Allerdings versuchen die Cyberkriminellen, darüber an die Bankdaten zu gelangen. Dafür bauen sie in der E‑Mail zusätzlichen Druck auf, indem sie schreiben, die Bestätigung müsse bis zum 31. August erfolgen. Nur dann könne die Erstattung ausgezahlt werden.
Verbraucherzentrale rät, solche Aufforderungen zu ignorieren
Die Verbraucherzentrale hat in der E‑Mail, die auch Mitglieder der t3n-Redaktion erhalten haben, mehrere Anzeichen für Phishing ausgemacht. Zum einen die unpersönliche Anrede und die unseriöse Absenderadresse, sowie eine Aufforderung zur Übermittlung von Kartendaten, den Verweis auf eine angebliche Elster-Identitätsprüfung und eine Frist zur Erzeugung von Handlungsdruck.
Die Verbraucherzentrale rät, solche Aufforderungen zu ignorieren und Phishing-Mails unbeantwortet in den Spam-Ordner zu verschieben, um eure sensiblen Daten zu schützen. Elster selbst weist darauf hin, dass sensible Daten nicht per Mail abgefragt werden: „Die Steuerverwaltung fordert niemals per E-Mail Informationen, wie die Steuernummer, Kontoverbindungen, Kreditkartennummern, PIN oder die Antwort auf Ihre Sicherheitsabfrage an.“ Falls ihr ein Elster-Konto nutzt, prüft neue Mitteilungen ausschließlich über das offizielle Elster-Portal.
Dieser Artikel wurde ursprünglich am 24.08.2026 veröffentlicht, interessiert jedoch immer noch sehr viele unserer Leser:innen. Deshalb haben wir ihn aktualisiert und hier nochmals zur Verfügung gestellt.

articles.title: 28 000 dollars d'IA en 28 jours : l'employé Microsoft qui a fait déborder le vase
articles.text:
Un tableur partagé entre collègues vient de dévoiler ce que certains salariés de Microsoft engloutissent en outils d'IA. Le record interne donne le tournis, et la direction a soudain redécouvert les vertus de la modération.
Depuis deux ans, Microsoft martèle à ses équipes que l'intelligence artificielle doit irriguer chaque tâche, chaque ligne de code, chaque réunion. Le message a été si bien reçu qu'un tableur interne, analysé par Business Insider, en expose aujourd'hui l'envers du décor. Un salarié de la division Customer and Partner Solutions y déclare 28 000 dollars de consommation d'IA en 28 jours. Une note interne obtenue quelques semaines plus tôt par 404 Media annonçait déjà, elle, un sérieux tour de vis.
Un tableur de salaires, 350 volontaires et un grand gagnant
À l'origine, ce document circule entre employés américains pour comparer salaires, primes et actions (une tradition de transparence assez répandue dans la tech). En 2026, une colonne inédite y a fait son apparition : « AI $ Usage Per Month ». Environ 350 salariés, sur plus de 223 000 dans le monde, y auraient renseigné leurs dépenses. Un échantillon volontaire et auto-déclaré, donc à manier avec des pincettes.
Les ordres de grandeur racontent malgré tout quelque chose. La médiane s'établirait autour de 300 dollars par période de 28 jours, avec des écarts saisissants selon les divisions : 975 dollars de médiane chez CoreAI, 526 chez Security. Les maximums individuels dépasseraient les 10 000 dollars dans plusieurs équipes. Au sommet trône ce fameux collaborateur à 28 000 dollars, dont on ignore s'il a automatisé la moitié de Redmond ou simplement laissé un agent tourner toute la nuit (les deux hypothèses ont leurs partisans en interne, on imagine).
Quand la métrique remplace le travail
Comment en arrive-t-on là ? Une partie de la réponse tient dans un mot inventé cette année par la tech américaine : le tokenmaxxing. Comprendre : consommer un maximum de jetons d'IA pour briller sur les tableaux de bord maison. Amazon a instauré des classements de consommation par employé, et Satya Nadella admettait en juin que ses propres équipes abusaient des modèles les plus coûteux pour des tâches banales. Mesurer la productivité au volume de jetons revient à évaluer un commercial au nombre de coups de téléphone passés : le compteur monte, la valeur produite reste un mystère.
Début août, Jay Parikh, patron de la division CoreAI, a sifflé la fin de la récréation. « Le tokenmaxxing n'est pas ce que nous optimisons », écrit-il dans sa note, avant de promettre une gestion des dépenses de jetons avec la même discipline que n'importe quelle autre ressource critique (c'est formulé poliment). Concrètement, GPT-5.6, un modèle d'OpenAI moins gourmand, devient l'option par défaut en interne, chaque division hérite d'un objectif de budget, et les salariés peuvent désormais suivre leur propre compteur. Une rallonge de surveillance, en somme.
L'épisode dépasse largement Redmond. Quand l'industrie entière commence à douter de la rentabilité de ses propres usages, les factures internes deviennent un indicateur avancé pour tout le monde. Si votre entreprise déploie Copilot ou un équivalent, la question mérite d'être posée avant que votre propre tableur ne s'en charge : combien coûte réellement chaque jeton, et surtout, que produit-il ?

articles.title: Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (August 31, 2026)
articles.text:
Startup news and updates: Daily roundup (August 31, 2026)
YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here's the roundup for Monday, August 31, 2026.
Athletes continue to inspire with super human performance as government readies further investments, YourStory brings you today’s headlines and the latest news across sectors.
Featured stories
How Shashruti Nakade went from a swimmer to a top para triathlete
Shashruti Nakade has gone from winning swimming medals to becoming a para-triathlete ranked World No. 9. After narrowly missing the Paris Paralympics, she is now working towards qualifying for the LA 2028 Games.
Read more
Key developments
NIIF raises Rs 19,000 Cr as first close in second fund
The National Investment and Infrastructure Fund Limited (NIIF), India's sovereign-anchored alternative asset manager has raised Rs 19,000 crore as the first close for its Rs 30,000 crore NIIF Infrastructure Fund II. The first close is anchored by the government of India and also saw participation from sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurance companies and leading Indian financial institutions.
Zomato tightens food safety norms, bans imitation cheese and paneer
Food delivery aggregator Zomato on Monday announced a zero-tolerance policy on the sale of analogue dishes including analogue cheese, paneer or other dairy products by restaurants listed on its platform, saying it reserves the right to delist non-compliant restaurants.
Govt notifies Rs 1,27,500-cr Semicon 2.0
The government on Monday notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme, setting in motion the Rs 1,27,500-crore plan that seeks to deepen India's semiconductor ambitions--from chip manufacturing to a full-stack ecosystem encompassing indigenous design and IP, equipment, materials, advanced packaging, R&D and talent development.
Funding news
DocPharma raises $2M led by Equentis
Healthcare quick-commerce supply chain platform DocPharma has raised $2 million in a Pre-Series A funding round led by Equentis. Existing investor 100Unicorns, along with Vinners and a consortium of strategic angel investors, also participated in the round. The company plans to use the fresh capital to build 100 new compliant and licensed dark stores, expand into newer cities and strengthen its infrastructure.
DocPharma has developed a proprietary SaaS platform integrating warehouse management, inventory intelligence, order management and fulfillment into a single operating system for healthcare. The platform offers real-time inventory visibility, routes orders to the nearest compliant fulfilment centre and enables prescription-compliant processing. It serves e-pharmacies, insurers, hospitals, wellness and other platforms, enabling delivery of medicines and healthcare products in under 30 minutes.
YOGa Clean Air raises Rs 20 Cr led by Info Edge Ventures
Cleantech startup YOGa Clean Air has raised Rs 20 crore in a funding round led by Info Edge Ventures, with participation from Zomato/Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal and Three Words Capital. The company plans to use the capital for expansion activities. Founded in 2010, YOGa has developed clean air bubble technology designed to filter incoming air and maintain a slightly higher pressure inside a space, preventing polluted air from entering. The system also manages carbon dioxide levels to keep indoor air fresh.
YOGa’s products have been installed across homes, hospitals, schools, offices and gyms in 11 cities. Co-founder and CEO Sachin Panwar said the funding would help the company take its clean-air technology to more homes, schools and hospitals across the country.
Other news
PhonePe launches UPI 123Pay for feature phone users
PhonePe has launched PhonePe UPI 123Pay, bringing UPI payment capabilities to feature phone users across India without requiring an internet connection. The service will come pre-bundled on devices from Nokia, HMD, Lava International and Itel Mobile, with additional handset manufacturer partnerships expected in the coming months. Built on a proprietary technology stack for feature phones, UPI 123Pay uses an SMS-based architecture designed to enable transactions even in areas with limited 2G connectivity.
Users can make peer-to-peer transfers through mobile numbers or UPI IDs and make peer-to-merchant payments using UPI IDs and QR code scanning. The service also allows users to check account balances and transaction histories. Upcoming features include bill payments, recharges and Aadhaar-based UPI onboarding, supported by an AI-powered voice helpline in English and 12 Indian languages.
MapmyIndia Mappls and ClarityX launch Geo-FI lending intelligence platform
MapmyIndia Mappls, in partnership with AI-driven data analytics and decision intelligence company ClarityX, has launched Geo-FI, a geo-intelligence stack designed for the lending sector. The platform aims to provide BFSI companies with a comprehensive view of borrower risk and opportunity by adding spatial intelligence to existing lending technology. Geo-FI integrates with loan origination systems, loan management systems, CRM and collections platforms without disrupting existing workflows. It can be deployed through APIs, spatial visualisation tools and SDKs, with on-premises, hybrid and cloud options.
The platform supports multiple stages of lending, including market identification, underwriting, location verification and collections. It uses geo-tagged field intelligence, delinquency heatmaps and AI-driven workflows to identify emerging risk clusters, recommend collection priorities and continuously improve location intelligence through customer and field-level data.
Paisabazaar says AI now generates 86% of new code
Financial products marketplace and free credit score platform Paisabazaar is accelerating the use of artificial intelligence across its organisation, with AI now generating around 86% of the new code written on its platform. The company said the shift is transforming how it builds and scales technology, improving development velocity and allowing teams to take on a larger product and technology roadmap.
Despite the increased role of AI, Paisabazaar is also expanding its technology team, indicating that productivity gains are being directed towards building more products and experimenting faster rather than reducing resources. AI-assisted development is being used across the engineering lifecycle, including coding, testing, debugging and documentation. Engineers continue to provide human oversight, while the company is placing greater emphasis on systems thinking, complex problem-solving, architectural decision-making and effective collaboration with AI tools.
Appinventiv launches free workspace programme for early-stage AI startups
IT services and digital transformation company Appinventiv has launched AspireHub, a dedicated workspace initiative offering free office space to early-stage AI startups in Delhi NCR. Startups with teams of one to 15 people located anywhere in Delhi NCR can apply for the programme. Selected companies will receive free workspace, high-speed internet, IT support and access to meeting rooms. Participants will also receive mentorship from Appinventiv’s leadership in areas including product development, branding and scaling.
Applications are open on a rolling basis, with startups evaluated on factors such as the founding team, product, market opportunity and execution capabilities. Appinventiv said a select number of participating startups may eventually move into a more structured incubation track, although details of that programme have not yet been announced.
Dreamtime Learning launches AI platform for schools
Dreamtime Learning has launched Dreamtime AiQ, an artificial intelligence platform designed to integrate classroom activity, student performance and stakeholder communication with existing school systems. The platform addresses the fragmentation of classroom, teaching and student engagement information across different systems by capturing and structuring day-to-day inputs. Designed to work alongside existing ERP systems, Dreamtime AiQ uses AI-led transcription and summarisation to convert classroom information into structured reports and updates. School leaders and founders can access information on classroom activity, teaching delivery and student engagement through a central dashboard, allowing them to review developments during the academic year rather than relying solely on periodic assessments.
Teachers can use the platform for administrative tasks including attendance, documentation, assignment evaluation and parent communication. Voice-enabled attendance and AI-supported assignment checking are designed to reduce routine administrative work.
Tiger Analytics named OpenAI Select Partner
Tiger Analytics has been named an OpenAI Select Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network, a global programme for partners building, selling and delivering AI solutions with OpenAI. The partnership will see Tiger Analytics work with OpenAI to help organisations build, deploy and scale AI solutions responsibly and effectively. The company will focus on accelerating enterprise AI adoption, translating advanced AI capabilities into domain-specific solutions and helping organisations maximise business outcomes. Tiger Analytics will help enterprises use OpenAI’s latest capabilities, including GPT-5.6 and ChatGPT Work, to improve productivity and address complex business challenges.
The OpenAI Partner Network brings together companies with industry expertise, delivery capabilities and customer relationships, while providing resources, enablement and support to help enterprises adopt frontier AI models and products and translate investments into measurable impact.
DashLoc launches AI-powered customer support platform DashDesk
AI-powered MarTech platform DashLoc has launched DashDesk, an AI-powered customer support platform designed to help businesses manage customer conversations, automate support operations and deliver faster, more consistent experiences from a single workspace. DashDesk brings customer support functions together on a unified platform, allowing businesses to manage tickets, streamline workflows, collaborate across teams and gain greater visibility into customer interactions.
Built around AI-led automation, the platform combines omnichannel ticket management with features including AI-assisted ticket routing, workflow automation and SLA management. It also provides knowledge base management, customer self-service portals, real-time analytics and customer satisfaction tracking. DashLoc said these capabilities are designed to help support teams improve efficiency and consistency while managing customer queries across channels through a centralised operating environment.
Salesforce expands Headless 360 for the agentic AI era
Salesforce is expanding Headless 360 as part of its evolution towards an agentic AI platform. The expanded offering includes new Model Context Protocol servers, Data 360 capabilities, Slack integrations, developer tools, reusable Skills and headless experiences across major Salesforce clouds. The company said the architecture enables authorised AI agents to securely discover, understand and take action across enterprise systems. Headless 360 is designed to turn Salesforce from a collection of enterprise applications into reusable business capabilities that AI agents can access securely.
Organisations can reuse existing Salesforce capabilities without rebuilding integrations for every new AI experience, while retaining established identity, permissions, metadata, workflows, governance and business logic. Salesforce said the approach builds on its history of openness, extending its enterprise web API philosophy to make trusted business capabilities available wherever AI agents operate.
ARC partners with Qualcomm to develop next-generation gaming devices
Indian gaming technology company ARC is building a new generation of gaming devices in collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies. The partnership will leverage Qualcomm’s expertise in high-performance computing, graphics, connectivity and gaming technologies to support ARC’s hardware development for India and other emerging markets. ARC aims to create gaming devices combining performance, portability and efficiency for a new generation of gamers. The planned devices are expected to focus on high-performance graphics, responsive gameplay, advanced connectivity and power-efficient operation.
ARC will also leverage Qualcomm Technologies’ capabilities across mobile computing, graphics, artificial intelligence, connectivity and power efficiency as it develops a broader portfolio. The company said the collaboration marks a significant step in its product roadmap, with the aim of delivering premium gaming experiences while keeping devices practical and accessible for everyday use.
PaySprint launches AI-powered multi-payment gateway platform
B2B Banking FinTech and RegTech infrastructure company PaySprint has launched SprintPGx, an intelligent multi-payment gateway platform designed for Indian enterprises. The platform connects businesses to more than 10 payment gateways through a single integration and uses artificial intelligence to route transactions in real time. PaySprint said SprintPGx is designed to address payment failures while improving conversion, reducing costs and supporting near-zero downtime without changing the customer checkout experience.
The platform operates as an intelligence layer between a merchant’s checkout page and multiple payment gateways. It analyses factors including card type, issuing bank, transaction amount, time of day and historical success rates before routing transactions to the gateway most likely to approve them. SprintPGx supports success-rate routing, cost-based routing and load balancing during peak periods such as festive sales and IPL ticketing.
NetApp named Leader in 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for enterprise storage platforms
NetApp has been recognised as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Storage Platforms, continuing its position as a Leader from the inaugural edition of the report in 2025. The evaluation considered the company’s Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. In Gartner’s 2026 Critical Capabilities report for Enterprise Storage Platforms, NetApp ranked first in the Hybrid Cloud Storage Use Case and second in the Hybrid Platform Services Use Case. NetApp said the recognition validates its ability to help customers address data challenges while providing more predictable hardware delivery timelines. Its platform provides governed access to data across locations and connects with AI and analytics ecosystems through hybrid multicloud storage.

articles.title: Ver Millonarios vs Internacional de Bogotá en Roja Directa y Fútbol Libre: el error que puede exponer tus datos a ciberdelincuentes
articles.text:
El juego entre Millonarios e Internacional de Bogotá, este sábado 30 de agosto de 2026, despierta pasiones y concentra miradas en la Liga BetPlay Colombia. Sin embargo, la búsqueda de alternativas “gratuitas” para ver fútbol online, como Roja Directa o Fútbol Libre, se ha convertido en una tendencia que expone a los usuarios a graves riesgos de seguridad digital.
La facilidad de acceso y la barrera de las suscripciones empujan a miles a recurrir a estos portales, sin reparar en las amenazas ocultas detrás de la transmisión ilegal.
PUBLICIDAD
En la era digital, el verdadero costo de ver partidos por vías no autorizadas puede ser mucho mayor que el de una suscripción oficial. La exposición a fraudes, robo de datos y malware convierte la opción “gratis” en una puerta abierta a los ciberdelincuentes.
Cómo funcionan los portales pirata de fútbol en línea
A diferencia de las plataformas oficiales como Win Sports, los sitios ilegales no cobran suscripciones ni ofrecen garantías de calidad o privacidad. Su rentabilidad depende de atraer tráfico masivo y monetizar cada visita mediante anuncios agresivos, banners, pop-ups y scripts que se activan con cualquier clic. Durante partidos de alto interés como los de Millonarios, la avalancha de usuarios incrementa el valor de cada interacción.
PUBLICIDAD
Estos portales suelen proliferar en clones con nombres y extensiones similares, lo que dificulta identificar fuentes legítimas y aumenta el riesgo de caer en trampas digitales. El clásico botón de “play” raras veces inicia el partido al primer intento: normalmente desencadena una cadena de ventanas emergentes, redirecciones a páginas de apuestas dudosas, encuestas engañosas y alertas de seguridad falsas.
Phishing y malware: el verdadero riesgo detrás de la transmisión “gratis”
Una de las tácticas más peligrosas consiste en solicitar datos personales, correos electrónicos o incluso números de tarjeta bancaria para supuestamente “activar HD” o “validar la cuenta”. Ningún servicio oficial requiere este tipo de información para permitir el acceso al contenido. Estas estrategias de phishing buscan robar credenciales y datos sensibles.
PUBLICIDAD
En dispositivos Android, el riesgo aumenta con la oferta de descargar archivos APK “necesarios” para ver el partido. Instalar aplicaciones fuera de Google Play puede introducir malware, spyware o troyanos que comprometen todo el teléfono, desde contraseñas hasta mensajes privados y datos bancarios.
¿Qué ganan los atacantes y qué pierden los usuarios?
Los atacantes monetizan cada clic y dato obtenido, desde la visualización de anuncios hasta la reventa de información en mercados ilegales. Los usuarios, por su parte, pueden entregar sin querer credenciales de correo y redes sociales, exponiéndose a fraudes, secuestro de cuentas o cargos no autorizados.
PUBLICIDAD
Algunos scripts maliciosos llegan a instalar software que roba contraseñas, accede a mensajes o incluso toma el control parcial del dispositivo, dando paso a extorsiones y robo de identidad.
Cómo identificar un sitio peligroso: señales de alerta
- Dominios con nombres alterados o extensiones poco habituales.
- Ventanas emergentes constantes, incluso sin interacción.
- Mensajes urgentes como “su teléfono está infectado” o “actualice ahora”.
- Promesas de “HD garantizado”, “sin anuncios” o “sin cortes”.
- Solicitud de tarjeta bancaria, contraseñas o permisos del sistema.
Si una página saturada de anuncios y solicitudes de información presume de ser “gratis”, esa es la verdadera trampa: monetiza cada dato y cada clic que realices.
PUBLICIDAD
Los partidos emitidos por servicios autorizados, aunque requieran pago o suscripción, ofrecen garantías de calidad, privacidad y seguridad digital. La elección de plataformas legales es la mejor defensa frente a las amenazas ocultas del streaming ilegal.
Proteger tus datos y dispositivos debe ser tan prioritario como disfrutar del fútbol en vivo. El costo de un acceso “gratuito” puede ser, en realidad, mucho mayor que el de una suscripción. La prevención, la información y la elección de servicios autorizados son la mejor estrategia para disfrutar del deporte sin exponer tu vida digital a riesgos innecesarios.

articles.title: Google Maps apporte un changement qui énerve tout un pays
articles.text:
Google Maps modifie l’affichage de sa carte à la suite d’un décret pris par le président américain. Une initiative qui suscite de vives réactions sur les réseaux sociaux, où l’entreprise se voit reprocher son manque de fermeté face aux décisions politiques.
Deux pays, un lac, deux noms
Le changement de nom découle directement d’une modification enregistrée dans le système officiel d’information sur les noms géographiques des États-Unis, le GNIS. Google applique une règle interne établie depuis longtemps, qui est d’adapter ses cartes aux sources gouvernementales officielles de chaque pays. La conséquence directe est que la mention « Lake America » apparaît désormais pour les utilisateurs situés sur le territoire américain.
Mais le nouveau nom n’apparaît pas partout. En effet, au Canada, l’appellation d’origine « Lake Ontario », utilisée depuis le XVIIe siècle et issue d’un terme iroquois signifiant « beau lac », reste inchangée. Pour le reste du monde, l’application fait le choix de la neutralité en superposant les deux dénominations : « Lake Ontario (Lake America) ».
Google Maps n’en est pas à son coup d’essai
L’application de cartographie de Google a déjà été modifiée à la suite de décisions prises par Donald Trump, rebaptisant le golfe du Mexique en « Golfe d’Amérique » ou le mont Denali en « Mount McKinley ». À l’époque, l’entreprise avait été accusée de supprimer des avis négatifs déposés par des internautes en colère à ce sujet.
Découvrez : 25 astuces de pro pour maîtriser Google Maps
Les réactions ne se sont pas fait attendre sur les réseaux sociaux. Plusieurs internautes jugent l’attitude de Google décevante, regrettant une capitulation face au pouvoir politique. D’autres soulignent que de son côté, Apple Maps a pour l’instant conservé le nom historique du lac.

articles.title: Amancio Ortega está dando un giro en la estrategia de crecimiento de Pontegadea: vender
articles.text:
Amancio Ortega lleva casi tres décadas comprando edificios, centros logísticos, hoteles e incluso instalaciones portuarias a través de Pontegadea utilizando una filosofía que les diferenciaba de su competencia: los activos son una fuente de ingresos desde el minuto uno, por eso no se venden.
De hecho, en las casi dos décadas de existencia del instrumento inversor de Ortega, pueden contarse con los dedos de una mano sus operaciones de venta. Sin embargo, algo está cambiando en la family office de Amancio Ortega. Por primera vez desde que el holding empezó a invertir en energía e infraestructuras, Ortega ha colgado el cartel de se vende.
Portugal recompra su red eléctrica. Hace unos días, la compañía portuguesa Redes Energéticas Nacionais (REN), comunicó al regulador bursátil luso un movimiento en el paquete de acciones que hasta el momento controlaba Pontegadea.
La estatal portuguesa Parpública compraría los 91.723.676 de acciones en poder de Pontegadea, por un precio aproximado de 380 millones de euros. Sin embargo, el holding de Ortega finalmente se embolsará un extra ya que la compañía estatal portuguesa pagará una prima del 17%, añadiendo 55 millones de euros más a la factura de venta, tal y como recogía el diario portugués Jornal Económico. De ese modo, Ortega gana dos veces: vende arropado por las subidas de la bolsa y cobra una prima extra del Estado por la operación.
Portugal quiere volver a controlar su energía. Portugal salió del capital de REN hace doce años. Lo hizo presionado por una acuciante crisis de deuda y bajo presión de la troika europea que le obligó a reducir su exposición a los vaivenes de los mercados.
Ahora, con una economía mucho más saneada, Portugal quiere volver tomar el control de sus sectores estratégicos, y el motivo tiene fecha propia: el apagón del 28 de abril de 2025. Aquel lunes, el sistema eléctrico de toda la península ibérico hizo un fundido a negro dejando sin luz a decenas de millones de personas en España y Portugal.
El primer ministro Luís Montenegro insiste en que esto "no lo hacemos para renacionalizar. Lo hacemos para participar, para salvaguardar el interés estratégico de Portugal en su infraestructura eléctrica". Su meta declarada es "participar en inversiones y decisiones estratégicas" utilizando su posición como principal accionista del operador para influir en el abaratamiento de la factura de la luz para los portugueses.
Una salida con premio incluido. Para Ortega, la reentrada del Estado en la operadora energética ha implicado una venta muy beneficiosa. Pontegadea entró como accionista de REN en julio de 2021. Lo hizo comprando el 12% a la omaní Mazoon por unos 190 millones de euros, cuando la acción rondaba 1,75 euros. A finales de 2025 sumó otro 1,7% por 38 millones de euros más. El viernes previo a la venta, el título de REN cerró en 3,54 euros, según reflejó Economía Digital.
Con esos números, la plusvalía obtenida por Pontegadea en estos cinco años ronda los 208 millones de euros, según calculó Cinco Días. Es la primera desinversión de Pontegadea desde que, en 2018, empezó a diversificar su negocio inmobiliario con participaciones en energía, telecos e infraestructuras. Hasta ahora, el holding inmobiliario de Ortega se limitaba a comprar activos.
Ortega deja la energía, pero solo en Portugal. La salida del accionariado de REN no implica que Pontegadea abandone el sector de las energías. Ortega se mantiene como el mayor accionista privado de Redeia, el operador equivalente de REN en España, controlando el 5% de sus acciones. Esta posición está valorada en unos 410 millones.
Además, Ortega conserva el 5% de Enagás, a través de Partler 2006, igualando la participación de la empresa estatal de inversiones (SEPI), tal y como reflejan los registros de accionistas de la gasista.

articles.title: PS5 Pro Stock Vanishes After GTA 6 Reveal, Prices Hit $1,300
articles.text:
Sunday, August 30th 2026
	
		
	
	
	
PS5 Pro Stock Vanishes After GTA 6 Reveal, Prices Hit $1,300
PS5 Pro consoles have all but vanished from major US retailers in the wake of GTA 6's extended Netflix reveal, with third-party sellers on Amazon and Walmart charging as much as $1,300 for units that normally go for $899. PlayStation Direct remains the lone major US retailer still selling at MSRP, while Best Buy and Target have sold through their stock entirely. eBay listings for new consoles have reportedly hit as high as $1,200, though there's no telling how many buyers are actually paying these scalper prices.
GTA 6 is confirmed to include PS5 Pro enhancements, though Rockstar hasn't detailed what those improvements actually are. Given how CPU-bound the console is, it's unlikely the Pro pushes GTA 6 past 30 FPS, so buyers chasing the "best" experience may be paying a hefty premium for a smaller gain than they expect. Sony is expected to restock retailers ahead of GTA 6's November 19 launch. For now, anyone not in a rush is probably better off waiting than paying a $400+ markup on a console that may not even hit a stable 40 or 60 FPS in the game.

articles.text:
OpenAI’s ChatGPT will have to comply with tougher EU rules such as removing illegal content or face potential fines, the European Commission said on Monday, as Brussels grapples with how its existing digital regulation applies to rapidly evolving AI services.
The Commission said the chatbot, social media forum Reddit, and gaming platform Roblox would be classified as so-called very large online platforms under the EU Digital Services Act, its landmark online safety regime.
The designation means all three services will face additional obligations such as removing illegal content and protecting the privacy and security of minors and could face fines of up to 6 percent of their global revenue if they fail to comply.
The decision marks a further expansion of the DSA into generative AI, with X’s AI chatbot Grok already facing an investigation under the law.
“ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox will now be held to a higher standard of scrutiny and accountability in the European Union, in line with their large impact on our citizens and society,” said the EU’s tech chief Henna Virkkunen.
The move comes after all three services surpassed 45 million monthly users in the EU, the threshold for enhanced scrutiny under the DSA. They now have until the end of December to comply with the additional obligations.

articles.title: You might soon be able to control Nanoleaf lights via the Philips Hue app according to this latest leak
articles.text:
It's (almost) official: you'll soon be able to add your Nanoleaf lights to a Philips Hue system, as a support page briefly appears online
Nanoleaf panels in the Hue app
- There's more evidence of a tie-in with Philips Hue and Nanoleaf
- An official support page appeared and then disappeared
- We could get an announcement about this later in the week
A few days ago we heard some whispers that Philips Hue would be adding support for Nanoleaf Shapes, meaning these lights could be controlled in the app — and now the integration has almost been officially confirmed.
As spotted by Android Authority, a support page for the Nanoleaf integration briefly went up on the Philips Hue website, explaining the types of light that would be supported, and explaining a little bit about how the tie-in will work.
That support page has now promptly disappeared again, suggesting that it was put up too early by mistake. According to the initial rumor, Philips Hue will be adding support for Nanoleaf integration on Thursday, September 3, which seems about right.
Put together that first leak and the brief appearance of an official support page, and it's now looking extremely likely that this will happen. However, until Philips Hue makes the announcement, nothing is guaranteed.
Nanoleaf panels behaving like Hue lights
According to the support page that has now been yanked from the web, the integration means Nanoleaf panels will "behave like a Hue light, ready to be used across your entire smart lighting setup".
There was also a line saying that Nanoleaf panels behave similarly to a gradient striplight", so you should be able to use the standard color wheel in the Philips Hue app to adjust the colors of the Nanoleaf panels you've got connected.
All of this will be made possible through a Philips Hue Wall Light Module that will connect to Nanoleaf devices. The support document lists Nanoleaf Hexagons, Triangles, and Mini Triangles as the smart lights that are going to be supported.

articles.title: Meeting notetaker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers | TechCrunch
articles.text:
The meeting note-taker market is a crowded space. Just in the last few weeks, dictation app Wispr launched its own note-taker and scheduling app, and Calendly added a similar tool to its stack. Dedicated meeting note-takers like Granola, Read AI, and Fireflies have raised millions of dollars in funding.
Likely in reaction to the intensifying competition, Y Combinator-backed Circleback is introducing a free subscription tier to allow users to get a taste of its product. The new plan lets users transcribe an unlimited number of meetings though they can only access their history for the last 30 days (Granola added a similar tier a few months ago).
The free plan lets users record meetings, access mobile and Apple Watch apps, use AI to query transcripts, and integrate the app with Linear and Slack. If customers want all integrations, unlimited meeting history, and full API and MCP access, the subscription plans start at $14 per month (paid annually). Prior to this change, Circleback didn’t have any free tier, and its plans started at $20.83 per month.
Founded in 2023 by Ali Haghani and Kevin Jacyna, Circleback raised $2.5 million in 2024. The company says it has been profitable since then, and has been clocking run-rate revenue of over $1 million per employee with a team of eight people, which roughly translates to a run-rate of about $8 million.
Haghani said due to the previously limited trial period, the company saw a big drop-off in users, which is why it is introducing a free plan.
“If we just open the gates and allow more people to use the product, that’s gonna bring Circleback in front of more people. Then we’re very good at making the product good and monetizing those users,” he said.
The company says it doesn’t spend on Google Ads or Meta Ads, and this free tier will serve as marketing expenses.
Haghani said the company is not immediately looking to raise funds despite interest, as it doesn’t see any bottlenecks in its growth trajectory.
“We are consistently competing and winning customers against much bigger companies, both in terms of number of people and funding raised. And I feel like there is now more of an appetite to win,” he said.
He noted that the moment the company realizes that money can solve a problem it is having, the startup would be open to fundraising.

articles.title: Strengere EU-Regeln für ChatGPT: Warum zu viele Nutzer OpenAI zum Verhängnis werden
articles.text:
Strengere EU-Regeln für ChatGPT: Warum zu viele Nutzer OpenAI zum Verhängnis werden
Für den KI-Bot ChatGPT, das riesige Online-Forum Reddit und die besonders bei jungen Menschen beliebte Spieleplattform Roblox gelten bald deutliche strengere EU-Regeln. Alle drei Internetangebote haben eine entscheidende Schwelle für Nutzerzahlen überschritten und müssen dadurch etwa beim Kinder- und Jugendschutz oder der Bekämpfung rechtswidriger Inhalte das Gesetz über digitale Dienste (Digital Services Act, kurz DSA) achten, wie aus einer Mitteilung der EU-Kommission hervorgeht.
Der DSA soll das scharfe Schwert der EU gegen große Online-Plattformen sein und gilt seit Februar 2024. Die Brüssel Internetwächter haben auf Grundlage des Gesetzes bereits zahlreiche Verfahren etwa gegen Tiktok, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat oder große Pornoplattformen eröffnet. Gegen Elon Musks soziales Netzwerk X oder die Online-Händler Temu und Aliexpress verhängte die EU-Kommission bereits Millionenstrafen, weil sich die Unternehmen nach Ansicht Brüssels trotz Ermahnungen nicht an die Regeln hielten.
Mehr als 45 Millionen Nutzer pro Monat auf den Plattformen aktiv
ChatGPT, Reddit und Roblox haben nun nach Angaben der Europäischen Kommission vier Monate Zeit, sich auf die neuen Regeln einzustellen. Alle drei US-Unternehmen hatten die Schwelle von durchschnittlich 45 Millionen Nutzerinnen und Nutzern pro Monat überschritten. Die EU betrachtet Reddit und Roblox dem Gesetz nach daher jetzt als sogenannte sehr große Online-Plattformen.
Für ChatGPT von der Firma OpenAI gilt bereits das KI-Gesetz der EU. Zusätzlich wird der Chatbot nun als sogenannte sehr große Online-Suchmaschine eingestuft und fällt damit unter den DSA.
Es war der größte Fehler der Europäer, dass sie Brüssel diese unfassbare und in keinster Weise demokratisch überwachte Macht gaben.
es gibt ein Parlament das quasi keinerlei echte Rechte hat und eine ewige Kommissionspräsidentin die wie eine Diktatorin über Europa herrschen kann.
Unbegreiflich, warum alle sehenden Auges dabei mitmachen.

articles.title: Lit 2 places, chaises pliantes et stores occultants : le Volkswagen ID. California Cruise ouvre l’ère des vans aménagés électriques
articles.text:
Si les camping-cars ne sont pas forcément bien vus, l’arrivée de modèles électriques pourrait changer la donne. Leurs motorisations parfaitement silencieuses ont en effet de quoi les rendre plus discrets en milieu naturel. Volkswagen ouvre ainsi le bal avec l’ID. California Cruise, un camper van basé sur l’original ID. Buzz. L’équipement est taillé pour le camping, même s’il faudra faire quelques concessions en termes de confort par rapport au California diesel.
L’aventure se fera déjà à deux, et non à quatre puisque l’engin abandonne le toit relevable abritant initialement un lit à deux places. Les deux occupants seront ainsi logés derrière le poste de conduite, sur un matelas de 9 cm d’épaisseur placé sur les banquettes rabattables. De quoi obtenir un lit de 2,03 mètres de long et 1,20 mètre de large. L’aménagement est donc un peu plus rudimentaire que sur le California.
Un aménagement pensé pour le grand air
On bénéficiera tout de même de stores occultants sur toutes les fenêtres permettant de plonger l’habitacle dans la pénombre à l’instar du modèle thermique. Disponible en option, le toit panoramique opacifiant gagne également un store afin de bloquer toute lumière extérieure. Volkswagen ajoute à cela deux chaises de camping pliables et une table amovible pour s’installer confortablement.
Notons également l’inédit mode California se présentant sous la forme d’une unité de commande supplémentaire permettant de régler diverses fonctions d’éclairage et de confort. Les ports USB sont aussi alimentés en continu alors que la climatisation chauffe ou rafraîchit l’habitacle tout au long de la nuit. Le système peut ainsi maintenir une température cible jusqu’à 48 heures en fonction de l’état de charge de la batterie.
Une prise de courant géante pour vivre en totale autonomie
L’ID. California Cruise intègre bien entendu un planificateur d’itinéraire et prend en charge la fonction Plug & Charge pour une authentification rapide sur les bornes. En outre, la charge bidirectionnelle s’avérera bien utile en camping avec sa puissance nominale continue pouvant atteindre 2 000 W pour une puissance maximale de 3,6 kW. Des machines à café, des bouilloires, des plaques de cuisson portables, des glacières et des chargeurs multiples pourront ainsi être alimentés.
De quoi stationner sur un emplacement dédié sans forcément avoir besoin de se raccorder à un réseau externe. L’ID. California Cruise présente des housses de sièges spécifiques, l’inscription California sur le hayon et l’appellation Cruise sur les flancs. Ce modèle sera disponible en empattement court ou long, ce qui laissera le choix entre les batteries de 79 et 86 kWh. L’autonomie sera forcément impactée, l’ID. California Cruise étant plus lourd.
Un tarif salé et une autonomie sous surveillance
Reste maintenant à voir si l’engin trouvera bien sa clientèle car à 60 761 € en Allemagne, il est très loin d’être donné. Et sa meilleure polyvalence pour le camping sera rattrapée par un rayon d’action amoindri par rapport au diesel. Rendez-vous l’année prochaine quand auront lieu les premières livraisons.

articles.title: From roots to returns: Why Indian real estate is drawing NRI interest
articles.text:
The Omaxe State
View Brand Publisher
From roots to returns: Why Indian real estate is drawing NRI interest
As India's real estate market expands, overseas Indians are looking beyond the traditional idea of owning a home back home. Infrastructure-led growth, organized retail, and new mixed-use destinations are opening up a wider investment opportunity.
For generations of Indians living overseas, buying property in India has carried an emotional significance that often goes beyond the investment itself.
A home in India meant staying connected to family, having a place to return to, or building something to pass on to the next generation. That connection remains, but the economics around it are changing.
India is in the middle of a real estate expansion that is changing both the scale of the market and the opportunities within it. A joint KPMG-NAREDCO study estimates that the industry could grow from around $290 billion in 2025 to $970 billion by 2030, driven by urbanization, infrastructure development, rising incomes, and greater institutional participation.
For non-resident Indians (NRIs), this presents a different proposition. Investing back home is increasingly about more than owning a residential property. It can also mean participating in the growth of commercial districts, organized retail, and emerging urban destinations.
From connection to opportunity
The growing economic engagement of overseas Indians with India is already evident.
India continues to be the world's largest recipient of remittances, with inward remittances reaching $144.79 billion in FY26, according to RBI data reported by Business Standard. While remittances cannot be equated with real estate investment, they underline the depth of financial ties between the Indian diaspora and the domestic economy.
Real estate is increasingly part of that relationship.
A July 2026 Equirus Wealth report identified sustained NRI investment as one of the factors supporting demand in Delhi-NCR's luxury housing market. It also noted that a weaker rupee had improved affordability for overseas buyers, alongside motivations such as portfolio diversification, wealth creation, and future family use.
Currency, therefore, can be an advantage, but it is not necessarily the reason to invest.
For an NRI earning in dollars, pounds or dirhams, rupee depreciation can reduce the effective entry cost of an Indian asset. But the longer-term proposition depends on something more fundamental: whether the location is creating sustained economic activity and demand.
Increasingly, that means looking at the infrastructure around an asset rather than the asset in isolation.
Following where cities are growing
Real estate has always been tied to infrastructure. A new road can change commute patterns. A metro line can expand the reach of a business district. Airports, convention centres and commercial hubs can create new pockets of economic activity around them.
Delhi-NCR offers a useful example.
Commercial activity across the region continues to expand. Delhi-NCR recorded 4.1 million sq ft of office leasing in the second quarter of 2026, while retail leasing reached 0.7 million sq ft, up 13% quarter on quarter and more than 1.2X year on year, according to Cushman & Wakefield. Mall vacancy also declined to 7.2%, with fashion and food and beverage among the leading demand categories.
Within this larger market, Dwarka is emerging as an infrastructure-led district. One of the biggest catalysts is Yashobhoomi, the India International Convention and Expo Centre. Developed with an investment of over Rs 25,700 crore, the project has added large-scale convention and exhibition infrastructure to a part of Delhi already connected to the airport and the Airport Express Metro.
The significance lies in what develops around infrastructure of this scale.
Convention centers bring business travellers. Better transport improves accessibility. Hospitality follows visitors, while retail, restaurants and entertainment cater to both visitors and local residents. Over time, these uses can reinforce one another, creating destinations rather than isolated real estate developments.
The rise of destination real estate
This coincides with another shift in Indian commercial real estate: consumers increasingly expect more from physical spaces. The traditional model of visiting a mall primarily to shop is giving way to destinations where retail sits alongside dining, entertainment, hospitality, sport and social experiences.
For investors, this changes how commercial property can be assessed. Footfall is no longer necessarily dependent on a single activity. Different parts of an integrated development can create different reasons to visit across the day, week and year.
It is in this context that projects such as The Omaxe State in Dwarka become relevant.
Being developed through a public-private partnership between the Delhi Development Authority and Worldstreet Sports Center, a wholly owned subsidiary of Omaxe Ltd, the 50.4-acre development brings together sports, retail, food and beverage, hospitality, and entertainment within one precinct. Its plans include a 30,000-seat international cricket and football stadium, indoor sporting facilities, retail spaces, restaurants, and entertainment infrastructure.
Its location alongside Yashobhoomi also reflects the broader investment thesis shaping parts of urban India: large public infrastructure can create the foundation, while private development builds complementary economic activity around it.
Making distance less of a barrier
For NRIs, another important change is practical.
Buying property in India while living abroad has historically involved layers of paperwork and dependence on people on the ground. Regulation today provides NRIs general permission to purchase residential and commercial properties in India, barring categories such as agricultural land, plantation property, and farmhouses.
Digital documentation, RERA disclosures, online payments and Power of Attorney-based processes have also made it easier to evaluate and transact remotely.
Together, these changes are widening the idea of what investing “back home” can mean.
The emotional connection has not disappeared. But it increasingly sits alongside a more investment-led assessment of infrastructure, connectivity, demand, and long-term economic activity.
For NRIs watching India's growth from thousands of kilometres away, that may be the bigger shift. The question is no longer simply whether to own a piece of home, but where India's next centres of activity are being built—and how to participate in their growth.

articles.title: La NASA se rinde con el telescopio Swift: su misión de rescate ha fracasado y solo queda exprimirlo antes de que se queme en la atmósfera
articles.text:
Al final no ha podido ser. La NASA ha puesto todo su empeño en rescatar al Observatorio Neil Gehrels Swift, el conjunto de telescopios espaciales que lleva meses cayendo lentamente en picado hacia una desorbitación inevitable. Dada la importancia de su trabajo, se lanzó una misión para devolverlo a una órbita más estable, pero esta ha fracasado y no hay tiempo de poner otra en marcha, así que toca asumir que el Swift tiene los días contados. Por eso, la NASA ha decidido exprimirlo hasta el final, para obtener la mayor cantidad posible de datos.
Encendido urgente de los telescopios. Todos los instrumentos de Swift llevaban varios meses apagados, con el fin de disminuir la resistencia que estaba provocando el declive de los telescopios. Sin embargo, ya no hay nada que hacer. Se van a caer de todos modos, por lo que lo más rentable es encender de nuevo los instrumentos y ponerlos a trabajar hasta que todo acabe. Por ahora, se han encendido dos de los tres telescopios y se ha empezado a recopilar datos. Cabe destacar que, con ello, aumentará de nuevo la resistencia con la atmósfera, por lo que volverá a acelerarse la desorbitación. No obstante, esta es la opción menos mala de todas.
Datos muy necesarios. El Observatorio Neil Gehrels Swift se lanzó en 2004 con el objetivo de estudiar algunos de los eventos más poderosos y explosivos del universo, como los estallidos de rayos gamma, las supernovas, las erupciones de rayos X y las galaxias impulsadas por agujeros negros supermasivos. Esto se debe a que es un observatorio multi longitud de onda, con instrumentos capaces de tomar datos tanto en la franja del espectro correspondiente a los rayos gamma como en ultravioleta/óptico y rayos X.
Una historia que se acaba. Las primeras dos décadas de Swift han sido un compendio de éxitos. Sin embargo, al no disponer de un sistema de propulsión propio, el rozamiento con la atmósfera terrestre residual ha ido frenándolo poco a poco, bajándolo a órbitas menos estables. A esto se ha sumado que últimamente hemos estado experimentando una actividad solar muy intensa, que ha acelerado aún más el desastre. Hay más de un 90% de probabilidad de que se desorbite y caiga de nuevo en la Tierra para finales de este 2026. Por eso, la NASA decidió lanzar la nave Link al rescate.
El rescate de la NASA que salió mal. La NASA contrató a la empresa Katalyst Space para construir una nave de rescate en tiempo récord. En solo 9 meses, Link estaba lista para salir en busca de Swift. El objetivo era que atrapase al observatorio con sus brazos robóticos y, gracias a su propulsor de xenón, lo impulsase de nuevo a una órbita más estable. Por desgracia, no ha podido ser.
Poco después del lanzamiento, que tuvo lugar el 3 de julio, la NASA comenzó a detectar los primeros problemas. Las ruedas de reacción de Link y su sistema de propulsión de gas frío no funcionaron correctamente, por lo que la nave comenzó a moverse en círculos, de forma totalmente descontrolada. Se hizo todo lo posible para, a través de los sistemas que aún funcionaban, devolverla a la normalidad, pero nada dio resultado. A mediados de agosto, la NASA y Katalyst Space dieron la misión por perdida.
De Swift al Hubble. El famoso Telescopio Espacial Hubble está sufriendo un proceso similar al de Swift. Poco a poco, se está desorbitando, por lo que sus responsables se plantearon la posibilidad de fabricar una nave como Link. Tenían reticencias sobre su rentabilidad. Sin embargo, ahora hay más motivos para las reticencias. Y es que, visto lo visto, rescatar un telescopio de su final inminente es mucho más complicado de lo que parece. Solo queda asumirlo, tomar todos los datos posibles y seguir de cerca su final. Se espera que la mayor parte de Swift se queme y desintegre al cruzar nuestra atmósfera, pero algunas piezas pueden llegar enteras a nuestro planeta. Lo más probable es que caigan al mar y no entrañen ningún riesgo; pero, por si acaso, será mejor tenerlo todo controlado.
